2  HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE K. SREENIVASA REDDY  Criminal Petition No.1940 of 2024 Order:
 This Criminal Petition, under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, is filed by the petitioner herein/A-3, to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.260 of 2019 on the file of the learned II Additional Junior Civil Judge, Sattenapalli, registered for the offences under Sections 420, 273, 270 IPC and Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Special Assistant Public Prosecutor for the State.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that this is a covered matter and earlier this Court has quashed several F.I.Rs and charge sheets registered for the similar offences based on identical facts and thereby prayed to quash the charge sheet in this Criminal Petition also.
4. Learned Special Assistant Public Prosecutor fairly concedes too with the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

5. As can be seen from the common order passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, dated 18.12.2019 it is evident that this Court has quashed several F.I.Rs registered for the  3 similar offences based on identical facts.
Therefore, the petitioner, who is similarly placed, is also entitled for quashing of charge sheet registered against him.

6. In view of the aforesaid order of this Court and for the reasons stated therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed quashing the proceedings in C.C.No.260 of 2019 on the file of the learned II Additional Junior Civil Judge, Sattenapalli, against the petitioner herein.

7. As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous applications, if any,
pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.

8. Registry to append a copy of the order in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, dated 18.12.2019 to this order.
 ________________________  K. SREENIVASA REDDY, J.
